parts.text: The worst days are when the authorities drop a sudden closure right in the middle of the day, and then keep shifting the boundaries and extending the end times while our customers' drones are already out flying in the corridors. What makes it so stressful is scrambling to update our map while trying to figure out just how badly the new shape of the closure disrupted everyone all at once. To top it off, sometimes the server decides to crash or restart right in the thick of all that chaos, leaving us blind for a few minutes while we just have to wait for it to come back up.
